text: dsh-skills-manager-plus 是面向 DSH 网页端的技能与命令管理插件。它在设置侧栏注册管理页面，并由主机端 API 读取和维护 DSH 技能文件及保存的提示词命令。用户可以浏览、创建、编辑、启停和删除技能，安装技能归档，也可以管理斜杠命令与 .agents 技能目录开关；已保存命令会出现在输入框的命令菜单中。适合希望直接从浏览器设置管理技能和复用提示词的 DSH 用户。插件通过 DSH 本机 web 服务工作，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-skills-manager-plus adds a DSH web settings page for managing skills and saved slash commands. Users can edit, enable, disable, or delete skills, install archives, and save reusable prompts for the composer menu. It also manages .agents skill roots and requires no extra API key.

Can I save reusable prompts and invoke them as slash commands?
How can I install a skill bundle from a zip or tar archive?
dsh-skills-manager-plus 的功能「技能维护」：在设置页查看、创建、编辑、启停和删除技能文件。用户可修改技能内容及调用开关，主机 API 将操作路由到技能存储逻辑。
dsh-skills-manager-plus 的功能「归档安装」：从网页选择 zip、tar 或 tar.gz 技能包并提交安装，可选择用户或项目作用域；服务端把归档交给安装逻辑并返回安装结果。
dsh-skills-manager-plus 的功能「保存提示词为命令」：在命令管理页保存命令名称、说明和提示词正文；命令注册到 DSH 命令菜单，调用时将正文及用户附加输入作为用户消息提交。
dsh-skills-manager-plus 的功能「.agents 目录开关」：从设置页批量启用或停用用户级及项目级 .agents 技能根目录；状态保存管理器实际停用的项目，以便切回时恢复这些技能。

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · 发布与验证：`npm publish` 成功只说明 registry 收下了包，**不代表用户真能拿到**：版本可能还没展开、
国内镜像没同步、`gitHead` 指向一个没推上去的提交、或者市场条目掉了。所以发布后必须验证：

```sh
GITHUB_TOKEN=<有 repo 权限的 token> npm run verify:release
```

依次检查：npmjs 有该版本且 `latest` 指向它 → `gitHead` 确实是默认分支上的提交 →
npmmirror 同步到同一版本且 tarball 校验和与 npmjs 一致 → GitHub Release 已发布 →
市场条目仍在。加 `--sync` 会先触发一次镜像同步再轮询等待：

```sh
GITHUB_TOKEN=... npm run verify:release -- --sync
```

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · 发布与验证：国内网络下 `registry.npmjs.org` 可能被 DNS 劫持（表现为自签名证书 `O=redirect-cnzz`、
本地 resolver 返回 `103.73.220.138`）或直接不可达，而 `registry.npmmirror.com` 正常。
这时给发布和验证都挂上本机 SOCKS 代理即可：

```sh
npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ --https-proxy=socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080 --proxy=socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080
dsh-skills-manager-plus README · 注意：走 npm run 时必须用 VERIFY_PROXY——npm 会把字面量 --proxy 当成它自己的配置吞掉：VERIFY_PROXY=socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080 GITHUB_TOKEN=... npm run verify:release

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · 配置写在哪里：技能的「唯一真相」是技能文件系统本身 —— 与 DSH 的技能提供者扫描的根目录完全一致：

```
~/.dsh/skills                           用户级技能
~/.agents/skills                        用户级 .agents 技能
<项目>/.dsh/skills                      项目级技能
<项目>/.agents/skills                   项目级 .agents 技能

每个技能是一个 `<name>/SKILL.md`（或扁平 `<name>.md`），带 YAML frontmatter。
启用 / 停用开关就是改写 `disable-model-invocation` 与 `user-invocable` 两个键，
其它字段（包括未建模的嵌套字段）在改写时逐字节保留。

命令保存在：

```
$DSH_HOME/commands/<name>.md
```

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · 配置写在哪里：每个命令一个 Markdown 文件，frontmatter 带 `name`、`description` 与可选的
`argument-hint`，正文即保存的提示词。文件会被监视，增删改后约一秒内重新注册到
DSH 的命令注册表，无需重启。

插件自身仅持有一个状态文件（`$DSH_HOME/skills-manager-plus.json`），记录导入开关、
被停用的命令名，以及哪些技能是本页批量停用的 —— 切换回「启用 .agents 技能目录」时
只会恢复这些技能，手工停用的不受影响。

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · 安全约定：- **只响应本机请求。** API 挂在同一个 loopback web server 上，非 loopback 来源直接 403。
- **写入被限定在本插件管理的目录内。** 提交的路径越过技能根目录会被拒绝。
- **状态文件原子改写**，加载时校验，损坏则重置为默认值。
- **命令以用户消息下发。** 调用 `/命令` 时，提示词通过 `agent.followup` 作为普通
  用户消息发送，权限与日志行为与用户本人输入一致。

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · Releasing and verifying：A successful `npm publish` only means the registry accepted the upload — **not** that users can
get it. The version may not be visible yet, the China mirror may not have synced, `gitHead` may
point at a commit nobody has, or the market entry may have dropped. So verify after every release:

```sh
GITHUB_TOKEN=<token with repo scope> npm run verify:release
```

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · Releasing and verifying：It checks, in order: npmjs has the version and `latest` points at it → `gitHead` really is a
commit on the default branch → npmmirror carries the same version with a tarball shasum identical
to npmjs → the GitHub Release is published → the market entry is still there. Add `--sync` to
trigger the mirror sync first and poll until it lands:

```sh
GITHUB_TOKEN=... npm run verify:release -- --sync
```

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · Releasing and verifying：On some networks `registry.npmjs.org` is DNS-hijacked (a self-signed `O=redirect-cnzz` cert, the
local resolver answering `103.73.220.138`) or simply unreachable, while `registry.npmmirror.com`
works. Route both publish and verify through a local SOCKS proxy:

```sh
npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ --https-proxy=socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080 --proxy=socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080
dsh-skills-manager-plus README · With npm run, use VERIFY_PROXY: npm swallows a literal --proxy as its own config flag.：VERIFY_PROXY=socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080 GITHUB_TOKEN=... npm run verify:release
section: With npm run, use VERIFY_PROXY: npm swallows a literal --proxy as its own config flag.

text:
dsh-skills-manager-plus README · Invoking the script directly can use --proxy.：node scripts/verify-release.mjs --proxy socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080
```

⚠️ **Never** disable `strict-ssl` to get past the certificate error — that hands your npm token to
whoever is intercepting. Going through the proxy gets you the real certificate. Full option
reference is in the header comment of `scripts/verify-release.mjs`.
section: Invoking the script directly can use --proxy.

text:
dsh-skills-manager-plus README · Where things live：Skills are the skill filesystem itself — the same roots the DSH skill provider scans:

```
~/.dsh/skills                           user skills
~/.agents/skills                        user .agents skills
<project>/.dsh/skills                   project skills
<project>/.agents/skills                project .agents skills

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · Where things live：Each skill is a `<name>/SKILL.md` (or a flat `<name>.md`) with YAML frontmatter. Enable/disable rewrites the `disable-model-invocation` and `user-invocable` keys; every other field (including unmodelled nested fields) is preserved byte-for-byte.

Commands live under:

```
$DSH_HOME/commands/<name>.md
```

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · Where things live：One Markdown file per command, with `name`, `description` and optional `argument-hint` frontmatter; the body is the saved prompt. Files are watched, so add/edit/delete re-registers on the DSH command registry within about a second, without a restart.

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · Where things live：The plugin keeps one small state file (`$DSH_HOME/skills-manager-plus.json`) tracking the import switches, disabled command names, and exactly which skills this page disabled in bulk — turning the `.agents` switch back on only restores those, never ones disabled by hand.

dsh-skills-manager-plus README · Safety：- **Loopback only.** The API sits on the same loopback web server; non-loopback sources get a 403.
- **Writes are confined to the managed roots.** A submitted path outside them is refused.
- **State file is written atomically** and validated on load; unparseable state resets to defaults.
- **Commands go out as user messages.** Invoking `/command` submits the prompt via `agent.followup` as an ordinary user message, so permissions and logging behave exactly as if the user typed it.
